title: External Infrastructure Assessment — External IP Ranges and Non-Web Services
goal: Add an external infrastructure assessment mode that tests external IP addresses from an outside-attacker perspective — covering all exposed services including SSH, RDP, VPN, SMB, databases, and non-web protocols, not just HTTP/HTTPS.
scope: Implement: (1) A new 'external-infrastructure' run profile that combines: nmap full port scan (-p- or configurable range) from external perspective against IP ranges/CIDR, service version detection (-sV), nuclei infrastructure CVE templates (not web templates), httpx for any HTTP services found, SSH audit runner (ssh-audit tool, available on Kali) for weak ciphers and key exchange algorithms, optional SMB check from outside (NetExec passive, no auth). (2) A new wizard tile: 'External Infrastructure' with icon 🖧, description 'External IP ranges, exposed services, SSH/RDP/VPN endpoints'. (3) A new run profile class: 'passive-external-infrastructure' (nmap discovery + httpx + ssh-audit, no exploitation) and 'active-external-infrastructure' (adds nuclei CVE scan). (4) Integration with EASM (backlog-67): if a domain is provided alongside IPs, EASM discovery runs first to find all IPs associated with the domain, then the infrastructure scan covers the full discovered IP space. (5) Finding normalization includes service-specific methodology tags: SSH weak ciphers → WSTG-CRYP, RDP exposed → WSTG-CONFIG, database exposed → WSTG-INFO. (6) The existing scope allowlist enforcement applies — only configured external IPs/CIDRs are scanned.
generation_reason: The user requested the ability to test external IP addresses. External infrastructure testing is distinct from web app testing — it covers all TCP/UDP services exposed to the internet, not just HTTP. Most real external pentests start with 'what does the internet see?' against the full IP space, not just the web application. This is a common enterprise requirement.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Passive and active tiers only — no exploitation in this slice. Scope allowlist absolute. SSH audit is read-only. No credential attacks against external services.

success_criteria: external-infrastructure run profile runs nmap full port scan + service detection against IP ranges.
ssh-audit runner tests SSH service configuration.
nuclei infrastructure CVE templates run against discovered services.
Findings include SSH weak cipher, exposed database, and exposed management interface finding types.
EASM integration: domain input triggers subdomain discovery + IP resolution before scan.
Wizard tile 'External Infrastructure' available in assessment type selection.
Tests cover profile execution, finding normalization, EASM integration, scope enforcement.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

before_promotion: Visual mission preview and full-phase authorization (backlog-78) is completed and logged.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with external infrastructure assessment implementation.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with external infrastructure as active assessment type.
